qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Trade-only counter-positioning, ~900 high-density local depots with in-stock availability, vertically integrated UK cabinet manufacturing, and confidential builder credit protect an extraordinary 61-63% gross margin and ~15-18% operating margin.
qualitative.note: Dominant UK trade-only kitchen compounder with unassailable builder relationships, >62% gross margins, and a net-cash balance sheet. Resilient through UK housing and RMI cycles due to vertically integrated manufacturing and local depot convenience. [5-10Y g: UK volume/share gains 2.0% + price 2.0% + depot revamps/France 1.0% + buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Gross margin expanded to 61.6% in 2024 and 62.7% in 2025 despite UK construction headwinds. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC is 20-34% (median 21.1%). Free cash flow conversion consistently 95-100%+ (FY25 Owner FCF £318.8M vs NI £267.7M). Zero financial bank debt (£344.5M cash balances outweigh financial debt, with reported debt comprising IFRS 16 depot leases); interest coverage >15x.
